assumptions_recorded: macro availability is modelled as the declared minimum lag (reference Wednesday + 1 day = Thursday 00:00 UTC); the real H.4.1/DTS releases are later in the day, and the decision cutoff (Sunday 23:00) is ~3.5 days later, so the model cannot create look-ahead at this cadence; RFC-049B's primary-source verification covers the actual release timing

the stationary-bootstrap block length is expressed in days and mapped to the trip grid (7 / measured spacing → 1 observation for these multi-week rules); the sensitivity at 2 and 3 trips is reported and does not flip any LCB sign
